lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-luminance circular pixel clusters arranged in multiple semi-parallel horizontal rows, with the highest-intensity local maxima concentrated in the upper-right quadrant of the visible flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the horizontal rows of high-luminance blobs to create a rectangular grid-like pattern of anchor nodes.
